items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: Jack Crawford, white band, had a bus... I'd been kind of working around and trying to get a bus... I went in and had been talking around with him [Chevy salesman], so when Jack got this, some salesman called me... it was the used bus that Jack Crawford was turning in.

ctx.x: Cover the period--how did you go to New York?

I went to New York--had a bus. I didn't buy it just for that trip. Just a little before then, well as I said, we were doing fairly well, we weren't in the money, but I bought a brand new--which was the cheapest bus you could get--like the school bus, but I painted it. I bought it brand new and painted it blue and white so then we had no trouble for a long time.

But before that time, before that bus, it was really comical. We were travelling in those cars and Jack Crawford, white band, had a bus that looked like the old stagecoaches, like something on top, like a caboose, and I'd been kind of working around and trying to get a bus and the Chevy Company, they had ordered a brand new bus for Jack Crawford and I went in
